ruleDefinitions.name: New RUN Key Pointing to Suspicious Folder
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious new RUN key element pointing to an executable in a suspicious folder Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Run.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\WOW6432Node\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Run.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\Run.*")) AND ((Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Perflogs.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\ProgramData\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\\\$Recycle\\\.bin.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Default.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\public.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\%temp\\%.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\%tmp\\%.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\%Public\\%.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\%AppData\\%.*")) OR ((Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND (Details = RGX(".*\\\\Favorites.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\\Favourites.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\\Contacts.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\\Music.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\\Pictures.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\\Documents.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\\Photos.*"))))) AND  NOT ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\RunOnce\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SoftwareDistribution\\\\Download\\\\") AND (Details = RGX(".*rundll32\\\.exe\\ .*") AND Details = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\WINDOWS\\\\system32\\\\advpack\\\.dll\\,DelNodeRunDLL32.*")) AND (Details = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*"))))
